005package org.wpilib.framework;
006
007import org.wpilib.driverstation.internal.DriverStationBackend;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.ControlWord;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DriverStationJNI;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.HAL;
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.RobotMode;
012import org.wpilib.networktables.NetworkTableInstance;
013import org.wpilib.system.Watchdog;
014import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableRegistry;
015import org.wpilib.util.Alert;
016
017/**
018 * IterativeRobotBase implements a specific type of robot program framework, extending the RobotBase
019 * class.
020 *
021 * <p>The IterativeRobotBase class does not implement startCompetition(), so it should not be used
022 * by teams directly.
023 *
024 * <p>This class provides the following functions which are called by the main loop,
025 * startCompetition(), at the appropriate times:
026 *
027 * <p>driverStationConnected() -- provide for initialization the first time the DS is connected
028 *
029 * <p>init() functions -- each of the following functions is called once when the appropriate mode
030 * is entered:
031 *
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>disabledInit() -- called each and every time disabled is entered from another mode
034 *   <li>autonomousInit() -- called each and every time autonomous is entered from another mode
035 *   <li>teleopInit() -- called each and every time teleop is entered from another mode
036 *   <li>utilityInit() -- called each and every time utility is entered from another mode
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * <p>periodic() functions -- each of these functions is called on an interval:
040 *
041 * <ul>
042 *   <li>robotPeriodic()
043 *   <li>disabledPeriodic()
044 *   <li>autonomousPeriodic()
045 *   <li>teleopPeriodic()
046 *   <li>utilityPeriodic()
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <p>Order within one loop iteration:
050 *
051 * <ol>
052 *   <li>{@link #driverStationConnected()}, once, the first time the DS is connected
053 *   <li>the exit function of the previous mode and the init function of the new mode, only on a
054 *       mode change
055 *   <li>the periodic function for the current mode ({@link #disabledPeriodic()}, {@link
056 *       #autonomousPeriodic()}, {@link #teleopPeriodic()}, or {@link #utilityPeriodic()})
057 *   <li>{@link #robotPeriodic()}
058 *   <li>{@link #simulationPeriodic()}, only in simulation
059 * </ol>
060 *
061 * <p>The mode-specific periodic function runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()}. Exactly one
062 * mode-specific periodic function runs per iteration.
063 *
064 * <p>exit() functions -- each of the following functions is called once when the appropriate mode
065 * is exited:
066 *
067 * <ul>
068 *   <li>disabledExit() -- called each and every time disabled is exited
069 *   <li>autonomousExit() -- called each and every time autonomous is exited
070 *   <li>teleopExit() -- called each and every time teleop is exited
071 *   <li>utilityExit() -- called each and every time utility is exited
072 * </ul>
073 */
074public abstract class IterativeRobotBase extends RobotBase {
075  private final ControlWord m_word = new ControlWord();
076  private RobotMode m_lastMode;
077  private final double m_period;
078  private final Watchdog m_watchdog;
079  private final Alert m_loopOverrunAlert;
080  private boolean m_calledDsConnected;
081
082  /**
083   * Constructor for IterativeRobotBase.
084   *
085   * @param period Period in seconds.
086   */
087  protected IterativeRobotBase(double period) {
088    m_period = period;
089    m_loopOverrunAlert =
090        new Alert(
091            "iterativerobot-loop-overrun",
092            "Loop time of " + m_period + "s overrun",
093            Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
094    m_watchdog = new Watchdog(period, () -> m_loopOverrunAlert.set(true));
095  }
096
097  /** Provide an alternate "main loop" via startCompetition(). */
098  @Override
099  public abstract void startCompetition();
100
101  /* ----------- Overridable initialization code ----------------- */
102
103  /**
104   * Code that needs to know the DS state should go here.
105   *
106   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization that needs to occur after the DS is
107   * connected, such as needing the alliance information.
108   */
109  public void driverStationConnected() {}
110
111  /**
112   * Robot-wide simulation initialization code should go here.
113   *
114   * <p>Users should override this method for default Robot-wide simulation related initialization
115   * which will be called when the robot is first started. It will be called exactly one time after
116   * the robot class constructor is called only when the robot is in simulation.
117   */
118  public void simulationInit() {}
119
120  /**
121   * Initialization code for disabled mode should go here.
122   *
123   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization code which will be called each time the
124   * robot enters disabled mode.
125   */
126  public void disabledInit() {}
127
128  /**
129   * Initialization code for autonomous mode should go here.
130   *
131   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization code which will be called each time the
132   * robot enters autonomous mode.
133   */
134  public void autonomousInit() {}
135
136  /**
137   * Initialization code for teleop mode should go here.
138   *
139   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization code which will be called each time the
140   * robot enters teleop mode.
141   */
142  public void teleopInit() {}
143
144  /**
145   * Initialization code for utility mode should go here.
146   *
147   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization code which will be called each time the
148   * robot enters utility mode.
149   */
150  public void utilityInit() {}
151
152  /* ----------- Overridable periodic code ----------------- */
153
154  private boolean m_rpFirstRun = true;
155
156  /**
157   * Periodic code for all robot modes should go here.
158   *
159   * <p>Runs after the current mode's periodic function ({@link #disabledPeriodic()}, {@link
160   * #autonomousPeriodic()}, {@link #teleopPeriodic()}, or {@link #utilityPeriodic()}) and before
161   * {@link #simulationPeriodic()}.
162   */
163  public void robotPeriodic() {
164    if (m_rpFirstRun) {
165      System.out.println("Default robotPeriodic() method... Override me!");
166      m_rpFirstRun = false;
167    }
168  }
169
170  private boolean m_spFirstRun = true;
171
172  /**
173   * Periodic simulation code should go here.
174   *
175   * <p>This function is called in a simulated robot after user code executes. Within a loop
176   * iteration it runs last, after the current mode's periodic function and {@link
177   * #robotPeriodic()}.
178   */
179  public void simulationPeriodic() {
180    if (m_spFirstRun) {
181      System.out.println("Default simulationPeriodic() method... Override me!");
182      m_spFirstRun = false;
183    }
184  }
185
186  private boolean m_dpFirstRun = true;
187
188  /**
189   * Periodic code for disabled mode should go here.
190   *
191   * <p>Runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link #simulationPeriodic()}. Never runs in the
192   * same iteration as another mode's periodic function.
193   */
194  public void disabledPeriodic() {
195    if (m_dpFirstRun) {
196      System.out.println("Default disabledPeriodic() method... Override me!");
197      m_dpFirstRun = false;
198    }
199  }
200
201  private boolean m_apFirstRun = true;
202
203  /**
204   * Periodic code for autonomous mode should go here.
205   *
206   * <p>Runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link #simulationPeriodic()}.
207   */
208  public void autonomousPeriodic() {
209    if (m_apFirstRun) {
210      System.out.println("Default autonomousPeriodic() method... Override me!");
211      m_apFirstRun = false;
212    }
213  }
214
215  private boolean m_tpFirstRun = true;
216
217  /**
218   * Periodic code for teleop mode should go here.
219   *
220   * <p>Runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link #simulationPeriodic()}.
221   */
222  public void teleopPeriodic() {
223    if (m_tpFirstRun) {
224      System.out.println("Default teleopPeriodic() method... Override me!");
225      m_tpFirstRun = false;
226    }
227  }
228
229  private boolean m_tmpFirstRun = true;
230
231  /**
232   * Periodic code for utility mode should go here.
233   *
234   * <p>Runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link #simulationPeriodic()}.
235   */
236  public void utilityPeriodic() {
237    if (m_tmpFirstRun) {
238      System.out.println("Default utilityPeriodic() method... Override me!");
239      m_tmpFirstRun = false;
240    }
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Exit code for disabled mode should go here.
245   *
246   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time the robot exits
247   * disabled mode.
248   */
249  public void disabledExit() {}
250
251  /**
252   * Exit code for autonomous mode should go here.
253   *
254   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time the robot exits
255   * autonomous mode.
256   */
257  public void autonomousExit() {}
258
259  /**
260   * Exit code for teleop mode should go here.
261   *
262   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time the robot exits
263   * teleop mode.
264   */
265  public void teleopExit() {}
266
267  /**
268   * Exit code for utility mode should go here.
269   *
270   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time the robot exits
271   * utility mode.
272   */
273  public void utilityExit() {}
274
275  /**
276   * Gets time period between calls to Periodic() functions.
277   *
278   * @return The time period between calls to Periodic() functions.
279   */
280  public double getPeriod() {
281    return m_period;
282  }
283
284  /** Loop function. */
285  protected final void loopFunc() {
286    DriverStationBackend.refreshData();
287    DriverStationBackend.refreshControlWordFromCache(m_word);
288    m_watchdog.reset();
289
290    // Get current mode; treat disabled as unknown
291    boolean enabled = m_word.isEnabled();
292    RobotMode mode = enabled ? m_word.getRobotMode() : RobotMode.UNKNOWN;
293
294    if (!m_calledDsConnected && m_word.isDSAttached()) {
295      m_calledDsConnected = true;
296      driverStationConnected();
297    }
298
299    // If mode changed, call mode exit and entry functions
300    if (m_lastMode != mode) {
301      if (m_lastMode != null) {
302        // Call last mode's exit function
303        switch (m_lastMode) {
304          case UNKNOWN -> disabledExit();
305          case AUTONOMOUS -> autonomousExit();
306          case TELEOPERATED -> teleopExit();
307          case UTILITY -> utilityExit();
308          default -> {
309            // NOP
310          }
311        }
312      }
313
314      // Call current mode's entry function
315      switch (mode) {
316        case UNKNOWN -> {
317          disabledInit();
318          m_watchdog.addEpoch("disabledInit()");
319        }
320        case AUTONOMOUS -> {
321          autonomousInit();
322          m_watchdog.addEpoch("autonomousInit()");
323        }
324        case TELEOPERATED -> {
325          teleopInit();
326          m_watchdog.addEpoch("teleopInit()");
327        }
328        case UTILITY -> {
329          utilityInit();
330          m_watchdog.addEpoch("utilityInit()");
331        }
332        default -> {
333          // NOP
334        }
335      }
336
337      m_lastMode = mode;
338    }
339
340    // Call the appropriate function depending upon the current robot mode
341    DriverStationJNI.observeUserProgram(m_word.getNative());
342    switch (mode) {
343      case UNKNOWN -> {
344        disabledPeriodic();
345        m_watchdog.addEpoch("disabledPeriodic()");
346      }
347      case AUTONOMOUS -> {
348        autonomousPeriodic();
349        m_watchdog.addEpoch("autonomousPeriodic()");
350      }
351      case TELEOPERATED -> {
352        teleopPeriodic();
353        m_watchdog.addEpoch("teleopPeriodic()");
354      }
355      case UTILITY -> {
356        utilityPeriodic();
357        m_watchdog.addEpoch("utilityPeriodic()");
358      }
359      default -> {
360        // NOP
361      }
362    }
363
364    robotPeriodic();
365    m_watchdog.addEpoch("robotPeriodic()");
366
367    TunableRegistry.update();
368    m_watchdog.addEpoch("TunableRegistry.update()");
369
370    if (isSimulation()) {
371      HAL.simPeriodicBefore();
372      simulationPeriodic();
373      HAL.simPeriodicAfter();
374      m_watchdog.addEpoch("simulationPeriodic()");
375    }
376
377    m_watchdog.disable();
378
379    // Flush NetworkTables
380    NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().flushLocal();
381
382    // Warn on loop time overruns, and clear the alert once the loop is back on time
383    if (m_watchdog.isExpired()) {
384      m_watchdog.printEpochs();
385    }
386    m_loopOverrunAlert.set(m_watchdog.isExpired());
387  }
388
389  /** Prints list of epochs added so far and their times. */
390  public void printWatchdogEpochs() {
391    m_watchdog.printEpochs();
392  }
393
394  @Override
395  public void close() {
396    m_loopOverrunAlert.close();
397    super.close();
398  }
399}
